**Repaired finding submitted: T4C — deviation (fallback target).**

Changes made in response to the verifier:

1. **Added the missing operative right** (new Section 4.1.1, inserted after p0024): "The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time, in whole or in part, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to HDI." This is a Company-only affirmative permission at the fallback notice level — no "notwithstanding" override was needed because Section 4.1 contains no prohibition to displace.
2. **Retained the cap proviso** on Section 4.2(a), which the verifier accepted as minimal and well drafted.
3. **Verified the cross-reference:** Section 3.1 is the Company's fee-payment provision ("The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent … of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month"), so the three-months-of-fees cap resolves to a real Company-payable stream.
4. **Rebuilt coverage consistently:** element 1 is now addressed by the insertion (not by the renewal sentence); the renewal sentence is relied on only for the two Vendor-side elements, so HDI's 90-day right reads solely as end-of-term non-renewal.
5. **Corrected the comment** to state that we are both adding the Company convenience right and capping the Termination Payment, rather than claiming Section 4.1 already permits our exit.
